chapter: Piano craft and the New York school
title: Tatum's health and death
summary: Tatum played constantly, walked a lot, drank beer, and died of uremia.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Art Tatum: the legend, the piano and the man

blocks.x: This is really all he did. His whole life was playing piano.
You can see it. He must have played piano from morning til night and night til morning, and never got... I've never seen...
Apart from his eyes, what sort of health did he enjoy?

Well, I wasn't around him that much, enough to know what his preferences were. But he was limited. You know, when you don't have your sight you're kind of limited. He could see a little bit, a little tiny bit. But...
Well, it limited him from the point of view of exercise.
I don't know. Because he would walk. He did a lot of walking. Friends would take him somewhere.
He died of uremia, didn't he.
We're talking about Tatum dying of uremia, which you think had something to do with the fact that he drank beer all the time, and his kidneys were...
